data.title: Adaptive Hashing
data.author: varjag
data.article_summary: 这篇文章讨论了在2024年ELS会议上作者关于自适应哈希的演讲，重点是如何使通用哈希表更快且更 robust。文章比较了理论与实践中的哈希表性能，指出实践中常数因素和固定哈希函数的影响。虽然完美哈希算法对特定键集效果好，但不适合通用用途。作者提出通过在线适应实际键集来优化哈希函数，从而减少碰撞并提高缓存友好性。文章详细介绍了在SBCL中实现自适应哈希的过程，包括对EQ和EQUAL哈希表的不同策略，如根据键类型调整哈希计算方式。最终，这些改进在常见情况下提升了性能，并在某些情况下增强了robustness。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于“自适应哈希”的定义和应用的讨论，以及对其优化和实际性能的看法。

不同观点：
• [tptacek] 认为“自适应哈希”这一术语曾经被用于描述如Bcrypt这样的技术，这些技术的目的是尽可能慢，以应对硬件进步。这与当前讨论的“自适应哈希”的目的正好相反，当前讨论的技术是为了提升性能。

• [heisig] 作为SBCL（Steel Bank Common Lisp）的用户，对自适应哈希表的优化表示赞赏。他认为这些优化显著提升了默认哈希表的性能，使得他不再需要在代码中使用性能 hack。他还提到，这种技术消除了许多极端情况下的低效问题，对哈希表用户来说是一个福音。

• [vlovich123] 提出了对哈希算法的具体优化建议，建议根据碰撞链的长度动态调整哈希的常量参数（如对字符串键仅哈希首尾各2个字符，或对列表键仅哈希前4个元素），以提高哈希质量并避免随着表的增长而增加的碰撞。

补充讨论：
• [tptacek] 的评论引出了一个关于术语“自适应哈希”的历史背景和不同应用场景的讨论，强调了其在不同上下文中的不同目标。

• [heisig] 的评论集中在自适应哈希在SBCL中的实际应用效果，特别是性能提升和代码简化方面的具体好处。

• [vlovich123] 的评论则聚焦于哈希算法的具体实现细节，提出了动态调整哈希策略以优化性能的建议，暗示当前的固定策略可能在某些情况下不够灵活。

争议焦点：自适应哈希的具体定义和目标。一部分人认为其目标是提升性能，而另一部分人（如[tptacek]）则指出该术语曾被用于描述完全相反的目标，即减慢计算速度。

43931925.article_content:
(QUOTE NIL)
Ramblings on
ai
,
lisp
,
tech
and
personal
topics by
me
.
Adaptive Hashing
Tags:
tech
,
lisp
,
Date:
2025-05-02
At the
2024 ELS
,
I gave a
talk on adaptive
hashing
, which
focusses on making general purpose hash tables
faster and more
robust
at the same time.
Theory vs Practice
Hash table theory most concerns itself with the asymptotic
worst-case cost with a hash function chosen randomly from a family
of hash functions. Although these results are very relevant in
practice,
those pesky constant factors, that the big-O cost ignores, do
matter, and
we don't pick hash functions randomly but fix the hash function
for the lifetime of the hash table.
There are
Perfect
Hashing
algorithms, that choose an optimal hash function for a given set of
keys. The drawback is that they either require the set of keys to be
fixed or they are too slow to be used as general purpose hash
tables.
Still, the idea that we can do better by adapting the hash function
to the actual keys is key. Can we do that
online
, that is, while
the hash table is being used? Potential performance gains come from
improving the constant factors mentioned above by
having fewer collisions, and
being more cache-friendly.
The images above plot regret (the expected number of comparisons of
per lookup minus the minimum achievable) and the measured run-time
of PUT operations vs the number of keys in the hash table with a
particular key distribution. Green is Murmur (a robust hash
function), Blue is SBCL's expedient
EQ
hash. The
wiggling of the graphs is due to the resizing of the hash table as
keys are added to it.
Note how SBCL's regret starts out much lower and becomes much higher
than that of Murmur, but if anything, its advantage grows.
Implementation
The general idea is sound, but turning it into real performance
gains is hard due to the cost of choosing a hash function and
switching to it. First, we have to make some assumption about the
distribution of keys. In fact, default hash functions in language
runtimes often make such assumptions to make the common cases
faster, usually at the cost of weakened worst-case guarantees.
The rest of this post is about how SBCL's built-in hash tables,
which had been reasonably fast, were modified. The core switching
mechanism looks at
the length of the collision chain on PUT operations,
the collision count on rehash (when the hash table is grown), and
the size of the hash table.
Adapting
EQ
hash tables
Init to to constant hash function. This a fancy way of saying
that we do linear search in a vector internally. This is an
EQ
hash table, so key comparison is as single assembly instruction.
When the hash table is grown to more than 32 keys and it must be
rehashed anyway, we switch to a hash function that does a single
right shift with the number of bits to shift determined from the
longest common run of low-bits in the keys.
If too many collisions, we switch to the previous default SBCL
EQ
-hash function that has been tuned for a long time.
If too many collisions, we switch to Murmur, a general purpose
hash. We could also go all the way to cryptographic hashes.
In step 2, the hash function with the single shift fits the memory
allocator's behaviour nicely: it is a perfect hash for keys forming
arithmetic sequences, which is often approximately true for objects
of the same type allocated in a loop.
In this figure, the red line is the adaptive hash.
Adapting
EQUAL
hash tables
For composite keys, running the hash function is the main cost.
Adaptive hashing does the following.
For string keys, hash only the first and last 2 characters.
For list keys, only hash the first 4 elements.
If too many collisions, double the limit.
So, SBCL hash tables have been adaptive for almost a year now,
gaining some speed in common cases, and robustness in others.
The full paper is
here
.

data.title: DIY solar launches in US – no installers or permits needed
data.author: jakestein
data.article_summary: EcoFlow推出了即插即用的Stream系列太阳能系统，适合房主和租户，无需安装团队或许可，价格从599美元起。该系统包括便携式太阳能板，可提供高达3,200W的太阳能，并且模块化设计允许用户选择是否配备电池。Stream Microinverter实时将太阳能转换为可用电力，起价599美元；Stream Ultra电池容量为1.92 kWh，可存储太阳能供日常使用或应急，售价1,899美元。捆绑购买价格为2,399美元。该系列产品首先在犹他州预售，计划未来几个月在美国全面推出，为预算有限或空间紧张的用户提供了经济实惠的太阳能选择。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于一款简单、安全的即插即用太阳能产品的可行性和技术细节。

不同观点：
• [conk] 支持该产品的理念，认为即插即用的太阳能产品很有意义。他提到产品可能通过让用户在上游断路器上安装电流互感器（CT）来确保不会超过分支电路的总负载，从而避免电线过载问题。

• [ethagnawl] 对该产品表示怀疑，特别是关于将电力通过墙壁插座反向输回电网的可行性。他对这种技术如何实现表示不解，暗示这可能存在技术上的挑战或安全隐患。

EcoFlow just launched a plug-and-play solar energy system for houses or apartments. Designed for homeowners and renters alike, the Stream series features a set of portable solar panels that don't require hard-wiring, permits, or installation crews to let you harness up to 3,200W of solar energy.

主要讨论点：大型科技公司使用人工智能模型处理和吸收已发布数据所引发的版权问题及相关讨论。

不同观点：
• **ArtTimeInvestor** 认为，将已发布数据用于AI模型是不可避免的，因为AI将被视为类似于人类智能的存在。他指出，人类通过阅读和吸收他人的作品来形成自己的世界观，并不会被视为侵犯版权，因此AI这样做也不应被视为侵权。他还提出了一个有趣的问题：如果人类可以随意使用AI的输出，AI自身会如何看待这种行为？同时，他质疑是否存在未经监督调整、仅通过网络数据训练的“原始”AI模型。

• **londons_explore** 表示，已经无法阻止利用网络数据训练AI的做法，即使法院判定这种行为非法，公司也可以通过隐藏或伪造训练数据记录来规避法律，或者将训练过程转移到海外进行。他认为，这种趋势无法被有效遏制。

• **yapyap** 则以讽刺的口吻指出，像Meta这样的公司现在可以无忧无虑地“盗版”数十亿本书。他的评论暗示了对大公司可能利用法律漏洞进行侵权行为的担忧和不满。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点在于，AI模型使用已发布数据进行训练是否构成版权侵犯。一部分人认为这是不可避免的趋势，另一部分人则认为这种做法应受到法律限制。
• 另一个值得注意的讨论点是关于AI的自主意识和权利的问题，ArtTimeInvestor提出了AI如何看待人类使用其输出的假设，这涉及对AI伦理和权利的更深层次思考。
• 此外，londons_explore提到公司可能通过隐藏数据或将训练转移到法律限制较少的地区来规避法律，这也揭示了全球化和技术发展带来的法律执行难题。

• **londons_explore** 表示，已经无法阻止利用网络数据训练AI的做法，即使法院判定这种行为非法，公司也可以通过隐藏或伪造训练数据记录来规避法律，或者将训练过程转移到海外进行。他认为，这种趋势无法被有效遏制。

• **yapyap** 则以讽刺的口吻指出，像Meta这样的公司现在可以无忧无虑地“盗版”数十亿本书。他的评论暗示了对大公司可能利用法律漏洞进行侵权行为的担忧和不满。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点在于，AI模型使用已发布数据进行训练是否构成版权侵犯。一部分人认为这是不可避免的趋势，另一部分人则认为这种做法应受到法律限制。
• 另一个值得注意的讨论点是关于AI的自主意识和权利的问题，ArtTimeInvestor提出了AI如何看待人类使用其输出的假设，这涉及对AI伦理和权利的更深层次思考。
• 此外，londons_explore提到公司可能通过隐藏数据或将训练转移到法律限制较少的地区来规避法律，这也揭示了全球化和技术发展带来的法律执行难题。

data.author: Alifatisk
data.article_summary:
`dart compile` 命令用于将 Dart 程序编译为目标平台的可执行文件或模块。通过子命令指定输出类型，包括：

1. **exe**：生成包含 Dart 运行时的独立可执行文件。
2. **aot-snapshot**：生成不含 Dart 运行时的 AOT 模块，需使用 `dartaotruntime` 运行。
3. **jit-snapshot**：生成 JIT 模块，包含中间代码和优化后的代码表示。
4. **kernel**：生成便携的中间代码模块。
5. **js**：生成可部署的 JavaScript 文件。
6. **wasm**（开发中）：生成 WebAssembly 二进制文件。

编译命令示例：
```sh
dart compile exe bin/myapp.dart -o /tmp/myapp
./tmp/myapp
```

支持跨平台编译，如为 Linux 系统编译：
```sh
dart compile exe --target-os=linux --target-arch=x64 hello.dart
```

`dart compile` 取代了旧的 `dart2native`、`dart2aot` 和 `dart2js` 命令。开发时也可直接使用 `dart run` 命令运行程序。

主要讨论点：Dart网站文档中的代码示例是否应使用`var`关键字或显式类型

不同观点：
• **支持使用`var`关键字**：Alifatisk认为在Dart语言的代码示例中应广泛使用`var`关键字，因为它可以简化代码，使代码更简洁，同时在许多情况下`var`可以推断出正确的类型，提高可读性。此外，使用`var`可以减少代码的冗余，避免开发者在每个变量声明时重复书写类型信息。

• **支持显式类型声明**：另一方观点（从Alifatisk的评论中推断）主张在代码示例中应使用显式类型声明，认为这样可以增加代码的清晰度和可预测性，特别是在教学或展示代码时，显式类型能让读者更容易理解变量的具体类型，有助于学习者理解Dart的静态类型特性。

补充讨论：
• **可读性与简洁性的权衡**：Alifatisk提到使用`var`可以让代码更简洁，但反对者可能认为显式类型声明有助于提高代码可读性，尤其是在面对复杂代码结构时。

• **对初学者的影响**：讨论中隐含的一个问题是，对于初学者来说，哪种方式更能帮助他们理解和学习Dart语言。支持`var`的一方认为简洁的代码有助于降低学习曲线，而反对者则认为显式类型更能帮助初学者掌握变量和类型的概念。

• **实际应用中的一致性**：还有一种观点认为，无论选择`var`还是显式类型，在Dart的文档和示例代码中保持一致性是非常重要的，以避免让开发者感到困惑。Alifatisk的评论表明，当前文档中存在不一致的情况，建议统一使用`var`或者显式类型声明。

争议焦点：使用`var`关键字与显式类型声明在Dart文档示例中的取舍，主要围绕代码简洁性、可读性、对初学者的影响以及文档一致性展开讨论。

dart compile
Overview
Subcommands
Types of output
Self-contained executables (exe)
AOT modules (aot-snapshot)
JIT modules (jit-snapshot)
Portable modules (kernel)
JavaScript (js)
This guide describes how to use the
dart compile
command to compile a Dart program to a target platform.
Overview
#
Use the
dart compile
command to compile a Dart program to a
target platform
. The output—which you specify using a subcommand—can either include a
Dart runtime
or be a
module
(also known as a
snapshot
).
lightbulb
Tip
To learn more information about this and other
dart
commands, check out the
Dart command-line tool page
.
Here's an example of using the
exe
subcommand to produce a self-contained executable file (
myapp.exe
):
dart compile exe bin/myapp.dart
Generated: /Users/me/myapp/bin/myapp.exe
The next example uses the
aot-snapshot
subcommand to produce an ahead-of-time (AOT) compiled module (
myapp.aot
). It then uses the
dartaotruntime
command
(which provides a
Dart runtime
) to run the AOT module:
dart compile aot-snapshot bin/myapp.dart
Generated: /Users/me/myapp/bin/myapp.aot
dartaotruntime bin/myapp.aot
To specify the path to the output file, use the
-o
or
--output
option:
dart compile exe bin/myapp.dart -o bin/runme
For more options and usage information, run
dart compile [<subcommand>] --help
:
dart compile exe --help
The
dart compile
command replaces the
dart2native
,
dart2aot
, and
dart2js
commands.
info
Note
You don't need to compile Dart programs before running them. Instead, you can use the
dart run
command
, which uses the Dart VM's JIT (just-in-time) compiler—a feature that's especially useful during development. For more information on AOT and JIT compilation, see the
platforms discussion
.
Refer to the
native_app
sample for a simple example of using
dart compile
to compile a native app, followed by examples of running the app.
Subcommands
#
The following table shows the subcommands of
dart compile
.
Subcommand
Output
More information
exe
Self-contained
executable
A standalone, architecture-specific executable file containing the source code compiled to machine code and a small
Dart runtime
.
Learn more.
aot-snapshot
AOT module
An architecture-specific file containing the source code compiled to machine code, but
no Dart runtime
.
Learn more.
jit-snapshot
JIT module
An architecture-specific file with an intermediate representation of all source code, plus an optimized representation of the source code that executed during a training run of the program. JIT-compiled code can have faster peak performance than AOT code if the training data is good.
Learn more.
kernel
Kernel module
A portable,
intermediate representation
of the source code.
Learn more.
js
JavaScript
A deployable JavaScript file, compiled from the source code.
Learn more.
wasm
WebAssembly
A portable, binary instruction format for a stack-based virtual machine. Currently under development.
Learn more.
Types of output
#
The following sections have details about each type of output that
dart compile
can produce.
Self-contained executables (exe)
#
The
exe
subcommand produces a standalone executable for Windows, macOS, or Linux. A
standalone executable
is native machine code that's compiled from the specified Dart file and its dependencies, plus a small
Dart runtime
that handles type checking and garbage collection.
You can distribute and run the output file like you would any other executable file.
Compile your app and set the output file:
dart compile exe bin/myapp.dart -o /tmp/myapp
When successful, this command outputs the following:
Generated: /tmp/myapp
Run your compiled app from the
/tmp
directory:
./tmp/myapp
Cross-compilation
#
Cross-compilation to Linux x64 and ARM64 is supported on the following 64-bit host operating systems: macOS, Windows, and Linux.
To use cross-compilation, include the following flags:
--target-os=linux
: The target operating system for the compiled executable. The Linux operating system is supported at this time.
--target-arch=value
: The target architecture for the compiled executable. The value for this flag can be
arm64
(64-bit ARM processor) or
x64
(64-bit processor).
The following command demonstrates how to cross-compile a standalone executable for a 64-bit Linux system:
dart compile exe \
--target-os=linux \
--target-arch=x64 \
hello.dart
Internally, this command downloads additional Dart SDK binaries and caches them in the
~/.dart
directory. Here's a sample output with the
--verbose
flag included with the command:
Downloading https://storage.googleapis.com/dart-archive/channels/dev/signed/hash/...4864.../sdk/gen_snapshot_macos_arm64_linux_x64...
Downloading https://storage.googleapis.com/dart-archive/channels/dev/raw/hash/...64e44.../sdk/dartaotruntime_linux_x64...
Specializing Platform getters for target OS linux.
Generating AOT kernel di

data.title: Migrating to Codeberg
data.author: todsacerdoti
data.article_summary:
Guix项目将在未来一个月内将其代码库、bug跟踪和补丁跟踪迁移到Codeberg平台。Codeberg是一个由非营利组织运营的源代码协作平台，使用GPLv3授权的Forgejo软件。此次迁移经过了数月的集体决策过程，并已在第二份Guix共识文件（GCD）中详细说明。关键里程碑包括：6月7日前所有Git仓库将迁移至Codeberg，5月25日Guix主仓库迁移；到2026年5月25日，Savannah上的仓库将作为Codeberg的镜像。直到2025年12月31日，仍可通过电子邮件提交bug报告和补丁。

对用户而言，主要变化是需要将`channels.scm`配置文件中的URL更新为Codeberg地址，但旧URL会保留镜像至少一年。对贡献者而言，迁移后可在Codeberg提交bug和拉取请求，但仍接受通过邮件提交的报告和补丁。此次迁移旨在改善工具链和基础设施，并提升项目的协作效率。

43959075.article_content:
Migrating to Codeberg
Ludovic CourtÃ¨s â May 11, 2025
The Guix project will be migrating all its repositories along with bug
tracking and patch tracking to
Codeberg
within a
month.  This decision is the result of a collective consensus-building
process that lasted several months.  This post shows the upcoming
milestones in that migration and discusses what it will change for
people using Guix and for contributors.
Context
For those who havenât heard about it, Codeberg is a source code
collaboration platform.  It is run by
Codeberg
e.V.
,
a non-profit registered in Germany.  The software behind Codeberg is
Forgejo
, a free software forge (licensed under
GPLv3) supporting the âmerge requestâ style of workflow familiar to many
developers.
Since its inception, Guix has been hosting its source code on
Savannah
, with bug reports and
patches handled by email, tracked by a
Debbugs
instance
, and visible on
the projectâs
tracker
.  Debbugs and Savannah are hosted
by the Free Software Foundation (FSF); all three services are
administered by volunteers who have been supportive over these 13
yearsâthanks!
The motivation and the main parts of the migration are laid out in
the
second Guix Consensus
Document
(GCD).  The GCD process itself was adopted just a few months ago; itâs a
major milestone for the project that weâll discuss in more detail in a
future post.  Suffice to say that this GCD was
discussed and improved
publicly for two months
, after which
deliberation among members of
Guix
teams
led to
acceptance
.
Milestones
Migration to Codeberg will happen gradually.  To summarize the GCD, the
key milestones are the following:
By June 7th, and probably earlier,
Git
repositories
will all
have migrated to
Codeberg
âsome have
already moved.
On May 25th, the Guix repository itself will be migrated.
From there on and until at least May 25th, 2026,
https://git.savannah.gnu.org/git/guix.git
will be a mirror of
https://codeberg.org/guix/guix.git
.
Until December 31st, 2025, bug reports and patches will still be
accepted by email, in addition to Codeberg (issues and pull
requests).
Of course, this is just the beginning.  Our hope is that the move can
help improve much needed tooling such as the
QA
infrastructure
following work on
Forgejo/Cuirass
integration
started earlier this year, and possibly develop new tools and services
to assist in the maintenance of this huge package collection that Guix
provides.
What this will change for you
As a user, the main change is that your
channels.scm
configuration
files
,
if their refer to the
git.savannah.gnu.org
URL, should be changed to
refer to
https://codeberg.org/guix/guix.git
once migration is
complete.  But donât worry:
guix pull
will tell you if/when you need
to update your config files and the old URL will remain a mirror for at
least a year anyway.
Also, channel files produced by
guix describe
to pin Guix to a
specific revision and to re-deploy it later anytime with
time-machine
will always work, even if they refer to the
git.savannah.gnu.org
URL,
and even when that repository eventually vanishes, thanks to
automatic
fallback to Software
Heritage
.
As a contributor, nothing changes for bug reports and patches that you
already submitted by email: just keep going!
Once the Guix repository has migrated though, youâll be able to report
bugs at Codeberg and create
pull requests
for changes.  The latter is
a relief for manyâno need to fiddle with admittedly intricate email
setups and proceduresâbut also a pain point for those who had come to
master and appreciate the email workflow.
For this reason, the âUser Interfacesâ section of the GCD describes the
options available besides the Web interfaceâcommand-line and Emacs
interfaces in particular.  Some are still work-in-progress, but itâs
exciting to see, for example, that over the past few months many
improvements landed in
fj.el
and that a
Forgejo-capable branch of
Magit-Forge
saw
the light.  Check it out!
A concern brought up during the discussion is that of having to create
an account on Codeberg to be able to contributeâsometimes seen as a
hindrance compared to the open-for-all and distributed nature of
cooperation by email.  This remains an open issue, though hopefully one
that will become less acute as
support for federation in
Forgejo
develops.  In the meantime, as the GCD states, occasional bug reports
and patches sent by email to
guix-devel
will be accepted.
Moving forward
This was an summary of what is to come; check out
the
GCD
for more info, and reach out to the
guix-devel
mailing
list
if you have any questions!
Real work begins now.  We hope the migration to Codeberg will be smooth
and enjoyable for all.  For one thing, it already proved our ability to
collectively decide on the projectâs future, which is no small feat.
Thereâs a lot to expect from the move in improving the projectâs ability
to work flawlessly at this scaleâmore than 100 code contributors and
2,000 commits each m

a 90 day reduction on tariffs
implemented in April, marking a significant attempt to de-escalate the trade war between the world’s two largest economies.
The deal was hashed out by US and Chinese officials in Geneva over the weekend, and will see the US reducing duties on Chinese imports from 145 percent to 30 percent, and China lowering tariffs on US goods to 10 percent, down from 125 percent. This new agreement doesn’t change the
removal of the de minimis exception on May 2nd
, which closed the tariff loophole that allowed businesses like
Temu and Shein
to send goods under $800 into the US without any added duties at all.
“We concluded that we have a shared interest,” said Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent at a
news conference in Geneva
. “We want more balanced trade, and I think both sides are committed to achieving that. Neither side wants a decoupling.”
The 90-day pause is meant to provide the two countries time to negotiate a final trade deal.

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：远程工作与社会结构变化对本地小商家的影响

不同观点：
• 第一种观点：问题的根本不在于远程工作本身，而在于社会结构的崩溃，导致一些人只索取而不回报。chmod775指出，像星巴士这样的连锁咖啡店，本来就不指望顾客会与店铺建立互惠关系。然而，本地的小咖啡店（mom&pop shops）如果出现大量蹭座、蹭网的人，则反映出该地区存在更大的社会问题。

• 第二种观点：chmod775认为，自己不会在空间有限的小咖啡店里长时间占用座位，因为这既不合适，也会影响其他顾客。他还提到自己常去的一家本地小咖啡店，与店员关系融洽，并且会注意不成为店铺的负担。如果自己的行为对店铺造成负面影响，他希望有人能提醒他。

补充讨论：
• 论据和例子：chmod775举例说明了“蹭座族”可能只点一杯咖啡却长时间占用座位，甚至自带食物，这会对小本经营的咖啡店造成经济压力。他还提到自己对常去的本地小店有情感上的认同，并且会自觉避免成为店铺的负担。

• 争议焦点：争议的核心在于远程工作者在咖啡店长时间工作是否合理，特别是在小型的本地商家。一方面，这种行为可能对商家造成经济损失；另一方面，部分人可能认为只要消费了就有权使用座位。这种行为的社会接受度与店铺的具体情况和社区文化有关。

data.title: Dotless Domains
data.author: wibbily
data.article_summary: 本文讨论了无点域名（dotless domain）的概念，即如「.com」或「.gov」这样只有一个标签的顶级域名（TLD），可通过浏览器或电子邮件服务器访问。无点域名在域名的DNS区域包含A/AAAA或MX记录时可实现。国际互联网名称与数字地址分配机构（ICANN）和互联网架构委员会（IAB）反对这种做法，并禁止通用顶级域名（gTLD）使用无点域名，但国家代码顶级域名（ccTLD）则由各国自行管理，因此历史上和目前都存在一些活跃的无点ccTLD例子。文章还列举了当前和历史上拥有无点域名的国家及其状态，并讨论了电子邮件协议对无点域名的限制。最后，文章提供了包含A/AAAA或仅MX记录的TLD表格，以及相关历史记录和截图。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于电子邮件地址和域名中TLD（顶级域名）以及"无点"域名的技术讨论

不同观点：
• **nulbyte的观点**：ICANN的SSAC并没有定义SMTP需要至少两个标签，且RFC5321明确提到可以使用TLD作为电子邮件地址的域名部分。这表明某些技术文档中对TLD使用的限制可能被误解或夸大。

• **tech234a的观点**：浏览器可以接受十进制形式的IP地址，例如将1.1.1.1表示为http://16843009。这说明浏览器在地址解析方面具有一定的灵活性，能够处理非传统格式的输入。

• **FlamingMoe的观点**：该帖子受欢迎可能与梵蒂冈域名冗余的评论有关，暗示公众对域名使用中的特殊案例有兴趣。

• **Animats的观点**：大多数浏览器将单个词视为搜索关键字而非域名。由于公司开始拥有自己的TLD，问题随之而来。即使直接输入"amazon"或"microsoft"并加上点，浏览器仍可能将其视为搜索关键字而不是直接进行DNS查找。

• **90s_dev的观点**：在编写电子邮件验证器时发现，根据研究结果，像"a@b"这样的格式在某些情况下可以是有效的电子邮件地址，只要TLD有MX记录。

• **tzury的观点**：所有域名，包括TLD，都是"."的子域，因此在NS记录中可以看到尾随的点。

• **hirsin的观点**：曾考虑将多个域名移到一个无点域名下，以便绕过3p cookies的限制，但由于ICANN和其他组织的反对，未能实现。

• **vzaliva的观点**：曾见过非常短的电子邮件地址（如??@ua），但由于大多数系统不识别，其实用性有限。

• **zatkin的观点**：提到拥有单字母域名和单字母电子邮件地址的趣事，并展示如何通过MX记录接收邮件。

• **zoky的观点**：提到一个例子，某人将URL写成com/foo/bar.html，省略了域名部分，显示了早期网络使用中的一些误解和习惯。

• **Tsiklon的观点**：提到曾与一位能够在TLD本身发送邮件的工程师共事，显示了在特定网络环境中TLD的特殊用法。

• **cduzz的观点**：提到每十年会尝试寻找奇怪的DNS名称，其中顶级域名解析为实际地址，并解释了"无点"域名仍需要尾随的点来规范名称。

补充讨论：
- 争议焦点在于TLD的使用及其在不同技术环境下的合法性和实用性，特别是在电子邮件地址和浏览器解析中的应用。
- 技术实现和标准文档（如ICANN和RFC）之间的差异和误解是讨论中的一个重要方面。
- 讨论还涉及到历史和技术背景下的趣闻轶事，增加了对TLD使用的实际理解。

43950525.article_content:
The term "dotless domain" usually refers to top-level domains (TLDs) –
think
com
,
gov
, etc – that are reachable themselves
using a web browser or email server.
That is, they are working domains that consist of a single label:
http://com/
, as opposed to
http://example.com/
; or
contact@gov
, as opposed to
[email protected]
. This can happen if the domain's DNS zone
contains A/AAAA or MX records in its apex.
[1]
Both the ICANN and the IAB are notoriously against the
practice,
[1]
[2]
so ICANN
prohibits it where it can – namely, on gTLDs.
[3]
However, ccTLDs (country code TLDs) fall largely under their own country's
jurisdiction! As such, there currently are and historically have been
examples of active dotless ccTLDs.
For email, the protocol itself would need to allow a dotless domain as a
destination address. According to ICANN's SSAC,
[1]
SMTP requires at least two labels (i.e.
domain.tld
) to deliver an
email, so it is unlikely Mauritania would receive an email sent to
contact@mr
, for example. For completeness' sake, however,
apex MX servers are listed below as well.
